_about: Ground truth for real Moglix product pages captured 2026-10-14 via the owner's Chrome. Written by reading each page's server-rendered price block text and JSON-LD directly, independently of rtech_sync.parsers. All prices INR. The price block reads '<incl> (Incl. of all taxes) <excl> + <gst> GST [MRP <mrp> <n>% OFF] [AVAILABLE ON REQUEST]'. JSON-LD Product.offers.price equals the incl-GST figure on every page EXCEPT the GM switch (see its notes). 'AVAILABLE ON REQUEST' pages carry JSON-LD availability OutOfStock and no ADD TO CART button: Moglix is not selling them, so they must not be used as a price source. Each Moglix variant (size, colour, poles) is its own /mp/msn... URL; the Havells page shows variant selector buttons but its JSON-LD describes only this MSN.
